claims.statement: zotero-plugin.config.ts is the single build definition: it declares source: ["src", "addon"], dist ".scaffold/build", addon identity and pref prefix from package.json config, templated updateURL/xpiDownloadLink, build.assets ["addon/**/*.*"], build.define constants (pkg.config plus author/description/homepage/buildVersion and the {{buildTime}} placeholder), build.prefs.prefix, and a test.waitForPlugin hook on Zotero.FlexAnnotate.data.initialized.

npm run build chains zotero-plugin build with npm run typecheck, and produces .scaffold/build/flex-annotate.xpi; .scaffold/ is gitignored and excluded from the wiki read boundary, so build behavior is documented from config and scripts rather than artifacts.

The build produces exactly two esbuild bundles, both bundled to target firefox140: the main bundle from src/index.ts (with __env__ defined from process.env.NODE_ENV, becoming addon.data.env) output to .scaffold/build/addon/content/scripts/flexannotate.js, and a separate pane bundle from src/prefs/preferences.ts output to .scaffold/build/addon/content/scripts/preferences.js.

The prefs script must be a separate bundle because Zotero loads pane scripts into a sandbox scope of the preferences window where only Zotero.*, window and document exist — no plugin globals like ztoolkit or addon; it is wired via the scripts entry of Zotero.PreferencePanes.register in src/hooks.ts and restricts itself to Zotero globals plus document, filling the Citavi locator menupopups and hiding unsupported options.

Because Zotero loads the pane script through the startup cache without ignoreCache (unlike bootstrap.js's loadSubScriptWithOptions with ignoreCache: true), edits to preferences.ts require starting Zotero once with -purgecaches or the stale copy keeps running.

addon/manifest.json pins compatibility in applications.zotero: id flexannotate@justanotherjurastudent.github.io, templated update_url, strict_min_version 7.0 and strict_max_version 10.*; all displayed values are __placeholder__ constants filled from build.define.

strict_max_version is mandatory on Zotero 10: without it the plugin is dropped silently at manifest parsing (verified on 10.0.1 with five otherwise identical plugins; extensions.strictCompatibility is false in Zotero defaults but the toolkit sets addon.strictCompatibility for release builds). The project rule is to raise strict_max_version on a new Zotero major version and re-verify with the version suite.

addon/bootstrap.js is fully templated and minimal: it registers chrome mapping content __addonRef__ to rootURI/content/, creates the sandbox context { rootURI } with _globalThis as the global root for the main bundle's addon/ztoolkit installation, loads content/scripts/__addonRef__.js with ignoreCache: true, and forwards Zotero lifecycle events to Zotero.FlexAnnotate.hooks, returning early from shutdown on APP_SHUTDOWN.

addon/prefs.js declares default preferences on the extensions.flexannotate.* branch (visibility flags, citationOnly, persistentCitationDialog, persistentWindowRect, keepEmptyPlaceholders, Citavi import keys including five locator defaults with citaviLocatorMargin defaulting to "paragraph"); the pane XHTML binds the same keys declaratively and src/utils/prefs.ts reads them via config.prefsPrefix, and these keys hold user data so they are never renamed.

addon/content/preferences.xhtml is the pane fragment registered at chrome://flexannotate/content/preferences.xhtml; it declares its own <linkset> with __addonRef__-preferences.ftl and __addonRef__-features.ftl for Fluent translation, declarative data-l10n-id/preference bindings, and five empty menupopups that the prefs bundle fills at runtime; content/icons/ supplies icon.svg (manifest 48/96, pane image, ProgressWindow icon) plus organizer and context-menu icons; content/zoteroPane.css is an unreferenced scaffold-template leftover.

User-facing strings ship as Fluent files addon.ftl, features.ftl, mainWindow.ftl, and preferences.ftl maintained simultaneously in addon/locale/de and addon/locale/en-US; onMainWindowLoad inserts -mainWindow.ftl and -addon.ftl into every main window, the preferences pane pulls preferences.ftl and features.ftl via its linkset, and the organizer is the exception with texts in src/features/organizer/strings.ts because it builds its DOM in code.

updates.json lists every published version (2.0.0, 1.2.0, 1.1.0, 1.0.0) newest first under the addon id, each with version, update_link to that release's xpi asset, and per-entry applications.zotero strict_min 7.0 / strict_max 10.*; the 2.0.0 entry adds a sha512 update_hash and its update_link matches the xpiDownloadLink template with the built name flex-annotate.xpi, while the 1.x entries use the pre-rebuild name flexannotate.xpi.

The update URL scheme is templated per build: updateURL resolves to https://github.com/{{owner}}/{{repo}}/releases/download/release/update-beta.json when pkg.version contains a hyphen (prerelease) or update.json otherwise, with owner/repo from the package.json repository; the built manifest receives it via __updateURL__, so installed builds poll the release GitHub tag and version bumps alone change nothing until a release is published.

Development serving uses zotero-plugin serve (npm start) configured via .env copied from .env.example: ZOTERO_PLUGIN_ZOTERO_BIN_PATH (escaped backslashes on win32, .app path on macOS), ZOTERO_PLUGIN_PROFILE_PATH, optional ZOTERO_PLUGIN_DATA_DIR, optional ZOTERO_PLUGIN_KILL_COMMAND, and optional GITHUB_TOKEN for local publishing; .env is gitignored and can be replaced by system environment variables for multi-plugin setups.

The verify gate runs lint:check (prettier --check . plus eslint from @zotero-plugin/eslint-config with no-unused-vars off for *.ts), build (which includes typecheck over src/typings/test-unit with sandbox typings and a second tsc -p test/tsconfig.json with mainWindow and mocha typings), test:unit and test:zotero in sequence.

CI runs three jobs on push/PR to main (lint, build uploading .scaffold/build as an artifact, test), while the Release workflow fires only on v** tag pushes and delegates to zotero-plugin-dev/workflows release-plugin.yml with build "npm run build" and release "npm run release", running with contents/issues/pull-requests write and secrets: inherit; dependencies are updated by weekly Dependabot npm updates with minor/patch grouped.

Release constraints: never push, release or tag without an explicit ask; commit only on instruction in Conventional Commits format (feat:, fix:, docs:, refactor:, test:, chore:); documentation ships in the same changeset as the code — README.md and CHANGELOG.md always, docs/anchors.md for new Zotero internals, docs/architecture.md for new pitfalls — with CHANGELOG.md following Keep a Changelog and SemVer and the Lattice changelog kept untouched in docs/lattice-changelog.md.

The preferences window features a dual-tab layout ('Einstellungen' / 'Settings' and 'Funktionen an/aus' / 'Features on/off') in addon/content/preferences.xhtml: the options tab displays static setting groups with gate-dependent visibility, while the features tab dynamically generates group boxes and checkboxes from FEATURE_GROUPS in src/prefs/featureGroups.ts, displaying bold main switches with indented child gates that are automatically disabled with dependency notes when required features are disabled.
